documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Upload and manage your PDF documents for AI-powered analysis.
documents.browseHint: or click below to browse · supports multiple files
documents.emptyDescription: Upload your first PDF above to get started.
documents.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes {filename} and its extracted chunks. This action cannot be undone.

documentPicker.empty: No processed documents yet. Upload and wait for processing to finish.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Have a conversation with your documents. Upload PDFs and ask any question — the AI answers using the content in your library and cites the exact sources it used.
chat.tip1: Upload at least one document before starting a chat
chat.tip2: Click "New Chat" in the sidebar to open a fresh conversation
chat.tip3: Attach specific documents to focus the AI on only those files
chat.tip4: Every answer includes source citations — click them to see the original passage

documents.label: Documents
documents.description: Your document library is the foundation of everything in DocuPilot. Upload PDFs here and the AI will index their full content for search and chat.
documents.tip1: Drag & drop one or more PDF files onto the upload area
documents.tip2: Wait for the status to change from "Processing" to "Ready" before using a document
documents.tip3: Use Re-ingest if a document needs to be reprocessed after an error
documents.tip4: Deleting a document removes it from all chats and search results

search.label: Search
search.description: Find specific passages across your entire document library using semantic search. The AI understands meaning, so you don't need to match exact words.
search.tip1: Type a question or a description of what you're looking for
search.tip2: Results are ranked by relevance, not just keyword frequency
search.tip3: Use the document filter to narrow results to a specific file
search.tip4: Click any result to see the full passage with page reference

generate.label: Generate
generate.description: Generate summaries and export them as polished PDF reports. Select source documents, add optional instructions, and the AI will draft the content for you.
generate.tip1: Select one or more source documents to summarize
generate.tip2: Add instructions to focus the summary on a specific topic or format
generate.tip3: Edit the generated content in the Markdown editor before exporting
generate.tip4: Click "Export" to download the final result as a PDF file
